artworks.title: Wooded Landscape
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a natural landscape featuring trees and dense foliage viewed from ground level. The forest canopy dominates the scene, obscuring the horizon. The trees are varied in size and spread out across the composition, with some surrounding a small opening. The sketch is done in pencil on a light paper, using varying shades of gray. The lines are loose and flowing, capturing the details of leaves and branches. The texture of the strokes ranges from bold to light, depicting different aspects of the scene.

artworks.title: The Devil's Tower
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a vertical rock formation near a body of water. The horizon is visible as the water meets the sky. The drawing uses charcoal strokes to depict the rocky terrain and water surface texture. The color scheme includes beige, charcoal, and white. In the distance, smaller rocks are seen, and on the right, there are hints of boats and reflections.

artworks.title: Chatsworth [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch from a direct viewpoint. The scene includes trees and a building in the distance. The horizon is positioned high in the composition, featuring a structure with architectural elements like columns and a flat roof. The drawing is light and delicate with faint pencil marks creating a soft effect. The tree lines are gentle and sketchy, suggesting leaves and branches. The ground is marked with sparse lines indicating texture or elevation changes. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of white and grey from the graphite pencil. The image includes small figures or details scattered throughout, enhancing the sense of depth and space.

artworks.title: Trees [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch showing a group of trees on the right side. The pencil strokes are light and delicate, creating texture without dense shading. The composition is primarily monochromatic, in shades of gray. The left side of the image is empty, emphasizing the trees on the right.

artworks.title: Hillside and Trees
artworks.medium: graphite with brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is subtly suggested by pencil outlines, with elements such as tree outlines and a distant structure visible. Loose and fluid brushwork in sepia tones creates a soft and ethereal quality. Darker strokes at the forefront indicate trees and shrubs, with a predominantly earthy brown color palette.

artworks.title: Llanberis
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown wash heightened with white on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with mountains merging into the sky. The soft brushstrokes depict a serene scene with gentle colors. In the foreground, there are cattle grazing, and in the background, a soft, creamy tone envelops the landscape.

artworks.title: A Cart with Two Horses near a Windmill
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a windmill on a hill in the distance. There are two horses and figures near a cart closer to the viewer. The drawing is done with charcoal in a dynamic style. The background has hints of structures. The color palette is mainly grey and black on a light-colored paper.

artworks.title: Kensington Gardens [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite with blue wash on illustration board
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in 19th-century attire gathered outdoors, likely in a garden or park. A man in the center wears a dark suit, a long coat, and a top hat, with his hands in his pockets. Next to him stands a woman in a long dress, bonnet, and holding an open parasol. Other individuals in similar attire are engaged in conversations or walking by. Trees in the background indicate an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Sketch of a Couple Seated with Cloud Studies [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and brown ink on illustration board
artworks.description: The image contains flowing and irregular abstract lines, with shapes reminiscent of waves or contour lines. In the center, there are two figures resembling people. Text is scattered around the composition.

artworks.title: Design for a Shakespeare Memorial
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash heightened with white on brown wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure standing on a globe or rounded pedestal, clad in robes suggesting authority or intellectual presence. Below the figure, two smaller seated figures appear engaged and attentive, with one holding what seems to be a garland or chain. The style is reminiscent of classical or neoclassical art, emphasizing themes of enlightenment, wisdom, or theatrical grandeur. The color palette is limited, using shades of brown with white highlights to create depth and emphasis, conveying a sense of drama and formality.

artworks.title: A Rocky Coast by Moonlight
artworks.medium: brown wash with blotting and surface scraping on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape view from a low angle, looking towards an expansive body of water. The horizon divides the ocean below from the sky above. There are no distinct objects on the horizon. The brushstrokes are textured and soft, with a subtle speckled effect creating movement in the water and sky. The color palette is primarily browns and sepia tones, creating an earthy and monochromatic feel. Rugged, rocky formations stretch into the water on the right, while the water extends into the distance, meeting a cloudy sky with varying shades of brown.

artworks.title: Figure Studies
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features three sketches of a person in 18th-century attire. The central figure is in profile, slightly leaning forward, wearing a coat and a tricorne hat. The individual's facial features are not detailed, and the hair is short. The clothing includes a long coat, stockings, and shoes. In the upper right, a smaller sketch shows the same person with hands behind their back. At the bottom right, another sketch displays the person from the back with the coat's fall and cuffs visible. The background is plain.

artworks.title: A View in India
artworks.medium: brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with water meeting land under a vast sky. The horizon line is slightly below the center, marking the meeting point of sea and land. A cluster of hills or mountains is visible on the horizon, with vegetation. Two sailboats float on the water, with their masts pointing towards the sky. The sky is almost monochromatic with a few soft clouds. The artwork is painted in light sepia tones, creating a serene and timeless atmosphere.

artworks.title: Sunset over the Valley
artworks.medium: gray and brown washes over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic view from an elevated position, looking out over a vast landscape. The horizon is just below the center of the composition, with a sky filled with layers of clouds. To the right, there are slender trees standing tall with branches reaching upwards. The brushwork consists of fluid strokes creating a serene atmosphere. The color palette is mainly grayscale and brown, evoking a calm mood. Two figures are standing on slightly sloped terrain, adding scale and human presence. In the distance, a small structure or ruin sits atop a rise, enhancing the depth of the scene.

artworks.title: Zahara
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a rocky hill in the center that appears to have castle ruins at the top. In the foreground, there are two figures with horses and another figure sitting nearby. Sloping hills can be seen on the left, leading into the distance. The color palette is predominantly muted with beige tones and hints of soft blue in the sky.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a wooded area dominated by trees. The viewpoint is within a dense forest, with a low horizon and a distant clearing. The brushstrokes are fine and precise, forming tree and foliage shapes. The grayscale palette features black ink tones on a beige background, highlighting the intricate details. A slope with bushes and grass leads to central trees, with more trees visible in the background.

artworks.title: A View near Lowther
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with black and white chalks over graphite on two joined sheets of gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape seen from an elevated perspective. The horizon line is in the middle, with distant hills and a layer of trees. It is created in a sketch-like style with soft brushstrokes or pencil marks, giving a sense of movement. The color palette is grayscale, with shades of gray and black, creating a calm atmosphere. In the foreground, a path winds through the scene, bordered by trees outlined with delicate shading.

artworks.title: "--And mist or glim, I'd sail with him, if he would sail with me--"
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite with scratching out on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated at a grand piano playing keys. She wears an elegant dress and a hat. A man sits across from her on an ornate chair. He has a mustache and is dressed in a suit with a waistcoat. The room is detailed with a piano, sheet music, floral arrangements, and a framed picture on the wall.

artworks.title: The Ilyssus!
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite with scratching-out on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a sculpture representing a reclining male figure, known as the Ilissos. The sculpture is shown in a beige or light brown color, suggesting it may be made from a material such as marble or a similar stone. The figure is in a reclining position, with its left arm bent and resting on a support, and its legs outstretched. In the foreground, a man is depicted from behind, wearing a suit and a top hat, observing the sculpture, providing a sense of scale and demonstrating how one might view such a sculpture in a gallery setting. The notes and style suggest an informal study or preparation for a presentation.

artworks.title: Two Children in the Snow
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite with scratching-out on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed, monochromatic pastoral scene with two figures walking on a path. The figures are dressed in period attire with hats, their shadows stretching across the sunlit path. Surrounding them are tall leafless trees with intricate shadows and bare branches. A house is faintly visible in the distance amidst the foliage. The landscape features detailed linework emphasizing texture, light, and shadow, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Seated Youth with a Staff
artworks.medium: graphite with brown wash heightened with white on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person seated in a contemplative position. The individual leans slightly to one side, with their right arm bent and resting on their cheek. They hold a long stick with their left hand, which extends upward. The person's facial features are detailed, with a focus on the eyes and soft expression. They have straight hair flowing over their shoulders, wearing a draped gown or robe that suggests movement. The background is a light beige tone, highlighting the figure.

artworks.title: The Horse of Selene from the Elgin Marbles [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of sculpted horse heads. Two horse heads are depicted, each part of a larger sculpture and mounted on separate pedestals. The drawing features a minimalist style with clean lines showing the strong musculature and dynamic poses typical of horses. The first horse head is in profile with an open mouth and defined ears. The second horse head focuses on its broad forehead and subtle contours, suggesting movement. Brown ink is used on a plain background to highlight the classic and timeless nature of the forms.

artworks.title: Study of a Horse [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse lying on its back, depicted with simple, fluid lines suggesting the outline of the animal with its legs raised upwards. The image emphasizes the motion and posture of the horse, with a textured, sepia-toned background. Small splotches and marks are scattered across the drawing.

artworks.title: Four Seated Figures
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a line drawing of four figures. The figures are sketched from the side, sitting down. Some figures face left with extended arms, while the figure on the left faces them. Facial features are minimal, with simple lines for eyes and noses. Long hair or head coverings are indicated by lines down their backs. The figures are unclothed, with no additional attire. The background is blank on lightly tinted paper with faint age spots.
